seo.description: Intelligent Auto-Regulating Livestock Heating Lamp Keep your chickens, chicks, ducks, and small livestock comfortably warm without dangerous fire hazards or harsh red glare. Digital Temperature Setting: Precision LED display from 28°C to 35°C (82°F–95°F). Automatic Heat Regulation: Automatically turns off when target temperature is reached and resumes when temps dip. 100% Safe & Fireproof: Sealed fireproof polymer shell with no exposed filaments or shattered glass. Even Warm Air Convection: Eliminates hot spots and cold corners. Standard E27/E26 Base: Easy screw-in installation with included US standard switch cord.
